prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE original square premium painterly naturalistic illustration of ZEUS, king of the Greek gods. Monumental full living figure dominates 80% of square, spectacular low camera looking up from tiny rugged Mount Olympus peaks into a vast tempest. Exactly one mature human head with thick DARK beard, two eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs. Regal commanding face. Fully opaque ivory Greek chiton covers chest and waist and legs, heavy deep indigo mantle with subtle gold trim. His right hand raises and grips a sharply branching white-gold THUNDERBOLT like a physical javelin, his left hand grips a tall royal sceptre; each hand clearly attached to its own arm. One natural eagle perched on a rock beside his feet, much smaller than Zeus, no other beings. Sky-wide branching lightning and immense turbulent storm clouds express his documented sky/weather domain, severe wind pulling drapery, powerful cool and gold reflected light. Tiny distant mountain ridge gives mythic scale, dynamic commanding pose and strong readable silhouette. Rich brushwork, skin and cloth realism, cinematic awe, no ordinary posed portrait. Respectful ancient Greek iconography, entirely original design. No magical body mutations, no extra limbs, no glowing eyes, no wings on Zeus, no flame, no modern movie/game/comic/anime design, no nudity, gore, text, inscriptions, logo, watermark or frame. Square at least 1024 by 1024.
depicted_variant: Regal mature dark-bearded Zeus above Olympus, grasping lightning javelin and royal sceptre with eagle.

visual_requirements.description: Regal mature dark-bearded man with one head, two arms, two legs; lightning held like javelin, royal sceptre and eagle.

Olympus mountain scale beneath the king of gods.

aura: Claim-grounded sky-wide lightning and storm; no invented body glow.

rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.
